title: CLAUDE.md
text: Data crosses FFI Arrow IPC stream bytes — never R lists. R side uses nanoarrow (R/convert.R → df_to_ipc / ipc_to_df); Rust side uses polars IpcStreamReader / IpcStreamWriter. three public R6 classes (Reader, Spec, Writer R/reader.R, R/spec.R, R/writer.R) hold .ptr Rust-owned struct (GgsqlReader, GgsqlSpec, GgsqlWriter declared src/rust/src/lib.rs). exported functions (ggsql_execute, ggsql_register, ggsql_render, etc.) thin R wrappers dispatch pointers. R/extendr-wrappers.R auto-generated extendr — edit hand. Regenerate rextendr::document() changing signatures src/rust/src/lib.rs.
code: R code (R/*.R)    │    │  R6 wrappers (Reader, Spec, Writer) → .ptr → extendr-wrappers.R    ▼ extendr FFI (.Call into src/rust/...)    │    ▼ Rust crate src/rust/  (depends on `ggsql` crate + polars + duckdb + extendr-api)

title: CLAUDE.md
text: Two-stage: configure script generates src/Makevars (.win) src/Makevars.via tools/config.R, R CMD build runs normal Makevars. Makevars shells cargo build --manifest-path=./rust/Cargo.toml, producing static lib (rust/target/<profile>/libggsql.) gets linked package .. Environment variables affect build (read tools/config.R): DEBUG set → cargo build (--release), implies NOT_CRAN. NOT_CRAN set → omit CRAN-required -j 2 --offline flags. webR (wasm32-unknown-emscripten) → sets --target, uses panic=abort profile overrides. editing Rust: run devtools::load_all() (triggers configure recompiles) rextendr::document() (also regenerates R/extendr-wrappers.R + Rd). normal R CMD build rebuild install. Offline/CRAN builds rely src/rust/vendor.tar.xz (cargo vendor archive). bump Rust deps, regenerate archive CRAN builds keep working.

text: adding changing Rust-exposed function: Edit src/rust/src/lib.rs — add #[extendr] fn impl method. Return Robj/Nullable<…> nullable values; use Raw byte buffers. Register item extendr_module! { ... } macro bottom lib.rs. Run rextendr::document() regenerate R/extendr-wrappers.R NAMESPACE useDynLib entries. Wrap new binding friendly R function appropriate R/*.R file (validate inputs rlang::check_required / check_string, error cli::cli_abort). Keep pattern: exported R fn → R6 method → .ptr$method(...) call. Data transfer: convert data frames Arrow IPC df_to_ipc() crossing boundary, back ipc_to_df(). Factors coerced character df_to_ipc nanoarrow doesn’t support dictionary IPC encoding — keep mind debugging column-type surprises. Rust side currently uses .expect("...") liberally; errors surface R panics caught extendr reported R errors. Prefer improving error messages R wrapper try_fetch / cli::cli_abort rather propagating Rust-style messages.

title: CLAUDE.md
text: Registered load (R/engine.R bottom: on_load(knitr::knit_engines$set(ggsql = ggsql_engine))). Key behaviors: Persistent reader per document: ggsql_env$reader caches default -memory DuckDB reader across chunks. Custom connection: "duckdb://..." chunk option → cached per connection string ggsql_env$readers. r:/py: data refs: resolve_data_refs() scans query r:name / py:name, pulls object knitr::knit_global() reticulate::py, registers __r_name__ / __py_name__, rewrites query. ggsql_table_names() hides names matching ^__(ggsql|r|py)_. sql.<tablename> proxy: injected knit global (Python globals reticulate live) later R/Python chunks can read back tables ggsql chunk created. Implemented S3 class ggsql_tables $, [[, names, print methods. Inline options: lines prefixed --| #| top chunk parsed YAML merged chunk options (kebab-case → dot-case, fig-alt becomes fig.alt). See parse_chunk_options(). Writer selection: chunk option writer = vegalite (default, HTML embed via vega-embed CDN), vegalite_svg, vegalite_png. LaTeX output auto-selects vegalite_png. SVG/PNG rendering goes V8 (see R/render.R, get_vega_ctx) optionally rsvg PNG. output.var: captures result (data.frame SQL, Vega-Lite JSON visual) knit env instead rendering. Syntax highlighting: register_syntax_highlighting() adds inst/ggsql.xml rmarkdown.pandoc.args Pandoc gets ggsql definition. chunk class.source defaults "sql" fallback.

title: Getting started
text: ggsql understands multiple backends, vignette focus DuckDB reader since powerful doesn’t require additional setup. create DuckDB reader using aptly named duckdb_reader() function: default creates connection -memory database, can point database file connect instead: reader mainly service executing queries , can something else well, e.g. register data available queries equal footing “real” tables database: can see tables currently available : wanted fetch data back using ggsql_table() (works registered native tables views), unregister using ggsql_unregister() (registered tables)
code: ddb <- duckdb_reader() ddb2 <- duckdb_reader("my/amazing/data.db") ggsql_register(ddb, gapminder::gapminder, "gapminder") ggsql_table_names(ddb) #> [1] "gapminder"

title: Getting started
text: mentioned, main purpose reader backend ggsql query executed. possible execute pure SQL queries get back data.frame: main motivation course create visualizations. vignette go detail ggsql syntax. , head documentation website. familiar ggplot2 able understand gist . can see, executing visual query produce plot, creates data structure contains information necessary render . analogue ggplot object create using ggplot2. can use object introspection, e.g. get visual part query:
code:
ggsql_execute_sql(ddb, " SELECT MAX(pop) AS population, country FROM gapminder GROUP BY country ORDER BY population DESC LIMIT 6 ") #>   population       country #> 1 1318683096         China #> 2 1110396331         India #> 3  301139947 United States #> 4  223547000     Indonesia #> 5  190010647        Brazil #> 6  169270617      Pakistan plot <- ggsql_execute(ddb, " SELECT * FROM gapminder WHERE year = 2007  VISUALIZE gdpPercap AS x, lifeExp AS y, continent AS stroke, pop AS size DRAW point   SETTING fill => null SCALE size TO (2, 15) ")  str(plot) #> <ggsql_spec> #> • Rows: 142 #> • Columns: stroke, size, shape, linewidth, pos2, fill, pos1, opacity #> • Layers: 1 ggsql_visual(plot) #> [1] "VISUALIZE gdpPercap AS x, lifeExp AS y, continent AS stroke, pop AS size
DRAW point
  SETTING fill => null
SCALE size TO (2, 15)"

title: Create a reader backed by R callbacks — custom_reader

title: Create a reader backed by R callbacks — custom_reader
code: custom_reader(execute_sql, register = NULL, unregister = NULL)

title: Create a reader backed by R callbacks — custom_reader
text: execute_sql function function(sql) executes sql returns either data frame raw vector containing Arrow IPC stream bytes (produced nanoarrow::as_nanoarrow_array_stream() / arrow IPC writers). register Optional function(name, df, replace) registers df table named name. replace TRUE caller expects existing table name replaced. unregister Optional function(name) removes previously registered table.

title: Create a reader backed by R callbacks — custom_reader
text: Reader object, usable anywhere *_reader() constructors accepted.

title: Create a reader backed by R callbacks — custom_reader
text: execute_sql required. register unregister omitted, calling ggsql_register() / ggsql_unregister() returned reader raises error.

title: Create a reader backed by R callbacks — custom_reader
code: # A trivial reader backed by a list of data frames in an environment, # delegating the actual SQL engine to an in-memory DuckDB. store <- new.env(parent = emptyenv()) backend <- duckdb_reader() reader <- custom_reader(   execute_sql = function(sql) ggsql_execute_sql(backend, sql),   register = function(name, df, replace) {     store[[name]] <- df     ggsql_register(backend, df, name, replace = replace)   },   unregister = function(name) {     rm(list = name, envir = store)     ggsql_unregister(backend, name)   } ) ggsql_register(reader, mtcars, "cars") ggsql_execute_sql(reader, "SELECT mpg, disp FROM cars LIMIT 3") #>    mpg disp #> 1 21.0  160 #> 2 21.0  160 #> 3 22.8  108

code: if (FALSE) { # interactive() && requireNamespace("shiny", quietly = TRUE) library(shiny)  ui <- fluidPage(   ggsqlOutput("chart") )  server <- function(input, output, session) {   ggsql_session_reader(duckdb_reader())    output$chart <- renderGgsql({     "SELECT * FROM r:mtcars VISUALISE mpg AS x, disp AS y DRAW point"   }) }  shinyApp(ui, server) }
